title: Björk
scene: 1970s Icelandic children’s pop and Icelandic-language cover recordings
notes: Childhood covers and original songs with live-band accompaniment, predating her international solo career.

title: Gling-Gló
scene: Icelandic jazz standards with Guðmundur Ingólfsson Trio
notes: Exuberant Icelandic vocal jazz foregrounds piano-trio interplay and agile, unpredictable singing.

title: Debut
scene: Early-1990s London club culture and Icelandic alternative pop
notes: London club rhythms meet jazz, brass, harp and startlingly intimate songs.

title: Post
scene: Mid-1990s London experimental dance and orchestral art-pop
notes: Industrial rhythms, trip-hop and orchestral cabaret shift rapidly between tenderness and exuberance.

title: Telegram
scene: UK/European experimental remixes of 1990s alternative electronic pop
producers: Björk|Nellee Hooper|Howie B|Tricky|Eumir Deodato|Evelyn Glennie|Graham Massey|Brodsky Quartet|Mark Bell
notes: Radically reworked Post material moves between jungle, string quartet, industrial noise and percussion.

title: Homogenic
scene: Icelandic electronic art-pop; experimental techno and string chamber arrangements
notes: Volcanic programmed beats collide with Icelandic strings and stark, dramatically focused vocals.

title: Selmasongs
scene: Dancer in the Dark film musical; industrial soundscape against orchestral show tunes
notes: Factory sounds become musical rhythms as theatrical orchestration follows Selma’s tragic story.

title: Vespertine
scene: Intimate Icelandic chamber-electronica and home-recorded microsound
notes: Whispers, tiny sampled sounds, music boxes, choir and harp form a private winter world.

title: Medúlla
scene: Icelandic avant-garde vocal art-pop with choirs, beatboxers and throat singing
influenced_by: Meredith Monk (Dolmen Music)|Ariel Ramírez (Missa Criolla)|Hamrahlid Choir
notes: Almost all voices: choirs, beatbox and throat singing replace instruments; sombre, hymnal.

title: Biophilia
scene: Icelandic app-album project: nature-themed art-pop on custom-built instruments
sounds_like: Nico (The Marble Index)|Aphex Twin [1/10]|Reprazent [1/10]|Squarepusher [1/10]|Thomas Newman (American Beauty) [1/10]|Antony and the Johnsons (The Crying Light) [1/10]|Steve Cravis [1/10]
notes: Gameleste, pendulum harps, Tesla coil and organ; hushed songs erupting into drum'n'bass.
